evidence.locator: PER training methods, Table 1, supplementary PER XLS
limitations: Nonrandomized pilot; PER 5 enrolled, 3 analyzed; two injury withdrawals, one training-related.
National competition outcome is not an individual gym forecast.
Spreadsheet Front squat labels conflict with manuscript SBD description. Original labels remain unchanged.

adaptations.load: Use verified workbook baseline reference and percentage with frozen user measured SBD maxes; nearest half-up user equipment increment. Original increment 2.5 kg. Cached example kg are never prescriptions.
adaptations.rest: User selects inter-set and inter-exercise durations; source duration not established.
adaptations.schedule: Sequential three-day weeks, 48-hour minimum between sessions; product spacing rule, delays allowed.
adaptations.roles: All numeric rows retained; no guessed warmup/work-set classification.
adaptations.assessment: Optional measured post-tests, with same/different/unknown conditions recorded separately.
adaptations.exercise_mapping: Preserve all literal supplement exercise labels, including front squat. Manuscript discrepancy remains unresolved.
adaptations.supervision: Independent execution differs from supervised research. Front squat experience and RPE familiarity are required product inputs, not automated technique assessment.

release_limit: Explicit selection by experienced adults meeting product scope; not automatic recommendation, source replication, or scientific approval.

product_scope.basis: Study population and RPE preparation plus explicit independent-execution product constraints.
